_note: Two headlines per round are real (real: true) with verified URLs. The headline marked real: false is the fake. Supports **bold** and *italic* in headline text. All real stories sourced from odditycentral.com.

headlines.text: Finnish businessman **fined $140,000** for exceeding the speed limit *by just 18 miles per hour*
Polish man *finally* passes his driving theory test **after 9 years** and 139 attempts
German learner driver **automatically awarded his licence** after examiners admitted they had *lost his test results* six times in a row
Indian woman files for divorce because her husband is **too nice** and *refuses to argue* with her
**15-year-old** German boy steals a bus and drives it *80 miles* to pick up his girlfriend from school
Japanese man **arrested** after sending his ex-girlfriend *3.2 million text messages* in one year — averaging one every 10 seconds
Nigerian woman spends **70 days** counting aloud to *1,070,000*, smashing an 18-year-old Guinness World Record
Scientists use **CRISPR** gene-editing to create a tomato that *smells exactly like butter-flavoured popcorn*
**Oxford researchers** develop a *caffeine-free coffee* that stimulates the exact same neural receptors — and tastes identical to espresso

Brazilian influencer **allegedly staged her own kidnapping at gunpoint** to *boost her social media following*

Airbnb rental *"for a party of seven"* swells to **800 teenagers**, ransacking a *$5 million* Texas mansion
Chinese film studio sparks outrage after officially casting **AI actors** as *leads in an upcoming drama series*
**TikTok** introduces *'Slow Mode'* — a 30-second delay before posting that the platform says has *reduced teen impulsive uploads by 40%*

German man's **right arm goes completely numb** for three weeks after *playing air guitar* at a festival, baffling doctors
Taiwanese university student **dies after gaming nonstop** for *four days and three nights* during the winter holidays
Indian woman **files a police complaint** against her husband — for making her do chores and causing her to *lose two Instagram followers*
**Netflix** quietly introduces a *'responsible viewing'* feature that automatically pauses binge-watching after five episodes and plays a motivational quote
Australian mother of three returns home to find **a stranger had been secretly living in her attic** — *for an unknown length of time*
Indian woman declared **brain-dead** miraculously *regains consciousness* after the ambulance carrying her hits a large pothole
Swedish couple returns from two-week holiday to discover *a family of beavers* has **built a dam in their basement**, flooding the ground floor
UAE woman goes to court seeking a **divorce** — because her husband *loved her too much* and never once argued with her
**'Jessica Foster'** — a *wildly popular Instagram soldier and Trump supporter* with over one million followers — turns out to be entirely AI-generated
UK court rules that a **30-second TikTok video** constitutes a *legally binding verbal contract* if it exceeds one million views
**Singaporean photographer Chuando Tan** turns 60 and goes *viral again* — still looking decades younger than his age with no surgery
Maryland homeowner **allegedly called ICE** on the migrant workers *fixing her roof* — reportedly to avoid paying the $10,000 bill
Canadian man **accidentally livestreams his own surprise birthday party** while trying to *stream a football match*, with 40,000 viewers watching in real time
A 21-year-old South Korean woman is accused of using **ChatGPT** to research lethal drug doses in order to *poison and kill* several young men she met online
A Chinese tech company staged a **kung-fu exhibition** with its humanoid robots, leaving audiences stunned — one robot successfully performed an *unassisted backflip*
A U.S. hospital's **AI triage system** began referring patients to *astrology-based treatments* — administrators say error rates are *'within acceptable margins'*
A 10-year-old boy in China took his own **father to court** after his dad spent the boy's *entire savings* without permission — and refused to pay him back
An Illinois daycare teacher was arrested for **feeding children chewable laxatives** so they would all get sent home sick — she told police she was *overwhelmed*
A 7-year-old in Singapore **incorporated an LLC**, hired his parents as staff, and now *docks their pocket money* if they're late to family dinners
An Italian man **trained his dog** to carry trash bags in its mouth and drop them in unauthorised locations — to *avoid paying* his municipal waste collection fees
**20 camels** were disqualified from Oman's annual *camel beauty contest* after judges discovered the animals had been given Botox injections and cosmetic plastic surgery
A pet parrot in São Paulo **called the police** while its owner was at work — officers arrived to find the apartment empty but spent 40 minutes taking the parrot's *'statement'*
A Russian man who couldn't find work **deliberately committed a crime** to get arrested, calculating that a prison sentence was a more reliable way to *survive the winter*
A Spanish man fired for drinking **up to 3 litres of beer** during work hours was awarded ***$55,000 in compensation*** by a court, which ruled his dismissal was disproportionate
A Hungarian man **resigned via spaghetti letter** — he argued that the contract required *hand-crafted* written notice, and the labour tribunal shockingly agreed
Italian stunt pilot **Dario Costa** made aviation history by becoming the *first person ever* to **land a plane on a moving train** — then take off from it again
A team of **Chinese teenage paper plane enthusiasts** broke not one but *two long-standing world records* — for longest distance and longest flight time — in under two months
Investigators found that a commercial jet had **flown to the wrong country** for six hours — the autopilot had been loaded with *entirely incorrect coordinates* and no one noticed
The African Hairy Frog — nicknamed the ***'Wolverine Frog'*** — **deliberately breaks its own toe bones** when threatened, forcing the shattered bone through the skin to *form sharp claws*
Scientists identified a parasitic ant species that **has no workers and no males** — it consists entirely of *queens* that reproduce by cloning themselves
Norwegian researchers documented the **first vertebrate that photosynthesises** — a fish that generates energy from sunlight via *symbiotic algae living in its scales*
A viral weight-loss hack has people **lining their mouths with cling film** before eating — the goal is to chew and *taste* food without actually *swallowing* any of it
A Chinese arcade was accused of **animal cruelty** after it began using *live hamsters* as prizes in its claw machine — customers could win them like stuffed toys
A Turkish spa sparked controversy by offering a ***'volcanic rock facial'*** where **crushed lava** is applied to the face at 60°C — waitlists now stretch to *nine months*
A Taiwanese woman was **sentenced to three months in prison** after using a *megaphone* to scream insults at her neighbours late at night — for *almost two years* straight
A French woman was **fined €1,250** after her neighbour complained that her *pet cat* kept trespassing onto his property — repeatedly and without invitation
A Swedish judge ordered a man to pay **€200 per month** as *'auditory compensation'* to his nextdoor neighbour after years of **practising trombone** between 6am and 7am on weekdays
Due to **surging demand** from mainland China and Hong Kong, *cow gallstones* have quietly become one of the world's most valuable commodities — now **worth more than gold** per gram
A Maltese chocolatier spent **four months building** the *world's longest chocolate sculpture*: a **55.27-metre steam train** made entirely of chocolate
An economist published a viral report showing that **storing apples in a cold garage** has *consistently outperformed the stock market* as an investment strategy over the past decade
A Russian tech startup has inserted **neuro-implants into the brains of cows** to monitor stress levels and boost milk yield — making them *the first animals* to receive such devices
A Brazilian man savagely attacked by two large dogs says he is **only alive today because his phone exploded** in his pocket — the *blast* was enough to frighten the dogs away
MIT researchers published a study showing that people who **charge their phones overnight** accumulate *3.7 fewer years of sleep* over their lifetime than those who charge during the day
